items.title: Norman Simmons interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 27, 2007 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I remember when Ron Carter first started his group and I went to see him.

ctx.x: In the backyards and stuff like that? The young people decided, hey wait a minute. Why should we listen to anything, the standards that you all are offering us. Because look where it brought us. It brought us to the end of the world. So that was a break then. And so it was the same break with the musicians. All of the sudden the musicians were not playing any standards. We couldn’t get up on the bandstand with the young musicians. Because they were not learning the same music we were doing. They were all doing…
